# AtFlow

AtFlow is a local LLM observability proxy and OTLP receiver. The Python distribution and CLI are named `atflows`.

Install: `python -m pip install atflows`
Run: `atflows` (requires Bun >=1.1.0)
Dashboard: http://localhost:3000
Proxy: http://localhost:8080/v1
OTLP traces: http://localhost:3000/v1/traces

AtFlow tracks requests, traces, tokens, costs, logs, metrics, models and sessions locally in SQLite. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama and other providers.

Source: https://github.com/aetna000/atflow
Upstream credit: https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow
